hypothesis: Attracting validated positive Event representations toward fixed incumbent-derived label centroids can improve Product-18 geometry without fabricating negatives.

prototype.formulation: one fixed centroid per Product-18 label
prototype.representation: L2-normalized final RoBERTa encoder CLS vector before the classification head
prototype.construction: L2-normalize each frozen-incumbent positive Event representation, mean within each validated label membership, then L2-normalize the centroid
prototype.multiLabelPolicy: a multi-label Event contributes independently to every validated label centroid and every corresponding attraction term
prototype.attractionLoss: mean over validated memberships of 1 - cosine(event_representation, fixed_label_centroid)

baseLossPolicy.choice: A: prototype auxiliary added to existing masked classification objective
baseLossPolicy.classificationLoss: positive-only masked BCE: mean softplus(-target_logit) over validated label memberships only
baseLossPolicy.unconfirmedCells: masked; never target 0 and never treated as negatives
baseLossPolicy.weightReason: both positive BCE and cosine distance are unit-scale; equal weight gives geometry a material role without a sweep

training.trainableParameters: RoBERTa encoder layers 10-11 only; classifier frozen

inference.evaluator: existing canonical Product-18 selector and frozen identical COSO/RTN comparison logic
